Noblis is seeking Software Developers at multiple experience levels to support mission-critical national security initiatives. The role involves designing, developing, enhancing, and integrating software solutions for federal clients across the software development lifecycle.
Software Developer (Multiple Levels) designing, building, and enhancing applications for performance, reliability, and distributed processing

Responsibilities:
• Apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve complex technical and mission challenges
• Develop cutting-edge solutions that improve system performance, reliability, scalability, and distributed processing capabilities
• Design, build, and enhance applications that support evolving client needs
• Work in an Agile environment to rapidly iterate, collaborate, and deliver impactful solutions for our clients

Requirements:
• an active TS/SCI with a Polygraph
• High School/GED

Skills:
• An active TS/SCI with a Polygraph
• High School/GED

Pay: $75K/yr - $189K/yr
